{{Quote|No, I don't trust their motives. That's my whole point. They can't be camped this close to us without wanting to sabotage us somehow. I know it, and I won't let it happen. I'll raise my concerns directly to Lord Ivress if I have to.|Sorven, in a message to Krigg|<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />}}
'''Sorven''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who joined the [[Order of Revan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sorven did not trust the Revanites who were former members of the Republic, and discussed the possibility that they would turn on the former Imperials with fellow Revanite [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Krigg]].
